title: Fix deprecation notices; stop using deprecated StoreTransport.GetImage
body:
1. common/libimage/manifests: stop using deprecated GetImage

   StoreTransport.GetImage has been deprecated since July 2023 ([containers/image#2056](https://github.com/containers/image/pull/2056)) in favor of storage.ResolveReference, but the deprecation notice was not in a separate paragraph, so linters did not flag its use.

   In list.Reference, the image is only looked up to obtain its ID, but `l.instances[""]` already is that ID. So, use it directly, and construct the reference using NewStoreReference rather than ParseStoreReference. This also fixes a subtle issue: GetImage looked the image up in the transport's default store, not in the store passed to Reference.

2. image: fix deprecation notices

   Some "Deprecated:" notices were not in a separate paragraph, so tools (staticcheck, gopls, pkg.go.dev) did not recognize them. Fix those (StoreTransport.GetImage, reference.SplitHostname, docker.ErrV1NotSupported, storage.ErrBlobDigestMismatch).

3. common/libimage/manifests: fix SaveToImage over existing image

   When saving a list to an existing image ID, SaveToImage did not record that ID in the list, so a subsequent Reference call failed with "appears to have not been saved first". Fixed, with a test case.

No API is removed.
